title: Ridgecrest earthquake-catalog construction (minimal instructions with expert tools) - development window
summary: Tools arm of the experiment: identical to the minimal-instruction baseline except that the local seismotools library (PhaseNet; GaMMA, PyOcto, REAL; NonLinLoc, HypoInverse; hypoDD, GrowClust, ccdt) is exposed with its validated usage documentation. Isolates the value of expert tools. Development loop: one day around the mainshock (2019-07-06T01:19:00Z to 2019-07-07T00:00:00Z).
